name: amanah/colocation-compare
title: Plan comparison
description: Dark section with the colocation plans side by side: footprint, access, power, starting price and who each plan suits. A table on desktop, stacked cards on phones. Each row links to the plan picker with that plan selected. Rows are a list edited in the code editor (cells accept <mark class="verify"> and <b>).

intro.default: The same power, cooling, security and network sit behind every plan. What changes is how much space you hold, who can open it, and how much power it draws.

note.default: Power, bandwidth and cross connects are quoted to your load.
